title: Furniture showroom
prompt: The video presents a spacious, well-lit furniture showroom with a modern, neutral aesthetic. A large, L-shaped sectional sofa in off-white fabric dominates the center, arranged around a round, rustic wood coffee table. The sofa rests on a textured, beige area rug, which contrasts with the polished white floor accented by brown geometric patterns. A sleek, white barrel chair sits nearby, complementing the sofa’s softness. Tall, gold-toned floor lamps with spherical bulbs cast a warm glow, enhancing the ambient lighting from overhead fixtures. In the background, dark wood shelving units display decorative items and framed art, while large windows reveal a parking lot outside. A tall potted plant adds a touch of greenery, and a bed set is visible further back, indicating a multi-room display. The overall atmosphere is clean, inviting, and curated for browsing.

title: Urban park
prompt: A continuous camera-controlled video reveals a sun-drenched urban park centered on a bronze statue of George Washington, standing atop a dark granite pedestal inscribed with his name and title. The statue, clad in historical military attire and holding a hat, faces away from the camera in the final view, revealing an engraved Masonic symbol. Surrounding the monument is a vast, meticulously manicured lawn of vibrant green grass, bisected by light-colored concrete pathways. Mature trees with dense foliage cast dappled shadows across the grass and paths. In the background, a grand, classical-style stone building with green-tiled domes and columns dominates the frame, flanked by modern glass-and-steel skyscrapers. Bright, direct sunlight creates strong highlights and long shadows, with lens flares visible in some shots, illuminating the scene under a clear blue sky with scattered white clouds.
